messages.name: ERCOT
messages.title: Non-Spin deployed
messages.text: ERCOT deployed Non-Spin at 100% of awards from 17:36 to 19:16.

messages.content: I’ll build the day-ahead book around morning and evening energy sales, charging from midday solar surplus, and ancillary-service awards that preserve battery headroom. I’ll then manage the live watches through settlement.

Actual regulation charging has been much lighter than projected, and ERCOT has deployed Non-Spin. We hold no Non-Spin awards, so there is no direct deployment obligation. I’ll reduce the remaining energy sales to protect the battery’s closing state of charge.
